verdict.rationale: Postman documents generating client SDKs from Collections/API specs (postman-docs-4) and exposes a public Postman API for programmatic access (postman-docs-5, postman-docs-27, postman-docs-41), which supports building against official SDK-like interfaces. However, there is no dedicated official SDK library documentation (e.g., language-specific SDK packages, versioned SDK reference docs, or first-party SDK repos) beyond the generic 'generate SDK' feature tied to collections. missing for 10: dedicated official SDK packages/repos for common languages, versioned SDK reference documentation, independent/hands-on confirmation that generated SDKs are production-grade and actively maintained.
